name: @tradrl/marketplace-service
description: The commercial capability marketplace service (Work Order T047): the layer where capability offerings are listed, discovered, engaged commercially and consumed under entitlements. Publishes provider offers as marketplace listings (offer snapshots + typed pricing — a later declaration supersession never rewrites what was listed), discovers them deterministically, commissions T045-shaped capability requests from recorded capability gaps with the offered consideration, and runs the engagement lifecycle's commercial half: purchases bind (listing, request, quote) under the budget law (the quote's counter-consideration never exceeds the platform's offered budget nor the listing's price — same commercial language, same currency), settle only on TERMINAL engagements (verified charges the tenant's spend allowance through the entitlements ledger — exact decimals; rejected and withdrawn never charge), and verified capability-artifacts mint the artifact-license entitlements that license the local L18 import. Zero runtime dependencies; mirrors, never imports (D-003/D-004); no ambient clock, no ambient randomness — injected instants and content-addressed ids only.
